name: 3-Slide Hook + Insight
description: Shortest useful carousel: grab attention, deliver one insight, close with a CTA.

name: 3-Slide Problem-Solution
description: Name the problem in the hook, show the fix, then ask for the next step.

name: 3-Slide Proof
description: Open with a claim, back it with one proof point, then CTA.

name: 4-Slide How-To
description: Two clear steps between hook and CTA. Best for simple processes.

name: 4-Slide Problem-Solution
description: Frame the problem, present the solution, then CTA.

name: 4-Slide Story + Lesson
description: A short story, one takeaway, then CTA.

name: 5-Slide Comparison
structure: Hook → Option A → Option B → Winner → CTA
description: Compare two options and declare a winner. Great for decision-making content.

name: 5-Slide Story + Insight
description: Share a compelling story and extract the key lesson.

name: 5-Slide Quick Wins
description: Deliver 3 quick, actionable wins that can be implemented immediately.

name: 5-Slide Problem-Solution
description: Identify a specific problem and present a clear solution with proof.
